description: Military Modernism , also known as Modern Tactical is an aesthetic, prominent from the mid-late 2010s that blends the high-performance, rigid functionality of contemporary, tech military equipment with the neutral palettes, sterile, stark geometries of modern design, and clean lines where it focuses heavily on ergonomics, stealth, high-tech structural materials and cutting-edge utility, unlike traditional military aesthetics that often depend on heritage vintage items such as WWII patches or brass-button peacoats, military modernism strips away the retro context.
